harnessText:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-bpyt.8.12: the round-2 mutants of syzygy-bpyt.8.8 re-run, plus one per predicate of the bounded read, the
fstat bound's two edges, and the three call-site mutants of R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-2 (X1, X2, X3).

Each mutant replaces one exact fragment (it must occur exactly once), runs the subject suites in their own process group, restores the
bytes and verifies their digest. Killed: at least one test failed, or the suite did not finish within the timeout (a reader that blocks).
Usage: python3 mutants.py <worktree> <out.json>
"""
import hashlib, json, os, re, signal, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2])
TIMEOUT = 300
SRC = 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/'
TESTS = [SRC + f for f in ['launched.test.ts', 'execution-choice.test.ts', 'brief.test.ts', 'inventory.test.ts', 'review.test.ts',
                           'session-view.test.ts', 'execution-rule.test.ts', 'render.test.ts']]
COMMAND = ['npx', 'vitest', 'run', '--project', '@syzygy/polaris-dossier', *TESTS]
L, CLI, H, R, B, I, V = (SRC + f for f in ['launched.ts', 'cli.ts', 'session-handover.ts', 'execution-rule.ts', 'brief.ts', 'inventory.ts', 'review.ts'])
SIZE_CHECK = "    if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX) return 'unreadable';"
READ_CHECK = "    if (length > MARKER_BYTES_MAX) return 'unreadable';\n"
LOOP = ("    while (length < bytes.length) {\n      const read = fs.readSync(fd, bytes, length, bytes.length - length, null);\n      if (read === 0) break;\n"
        "      length += read;\n    }\n")
BOUNDED_READ = ("    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(MARKER_BYTES_MAX + 1);\n    let length = 0;\n" + LOOP + READ_CHECK
                + "    const marker = JSON.parse(bytes.toString('utf8', 0, length)) as unknown;\n")
WORDING = "is not ${expectedLaunch(launchedMarkerState(run))} of that session's prompt"
OPEN_FLAGS = 'fs.constants.O_RDONLY | fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW | fs.constants.O_NONBLOCK'

MUTANTS = [
    ('open-error-absent', L, "    return (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT' ? 'absent' : 'unreadable';", "    return 'absent';"),
    ('parse-failure-absent', L, "  } catch {\n    return 'unreadable';\n  } finally {", "  } catch {\n    return 'absent';\n  } finally {"),
    ('foreign-shape-absent', L, "=== LAUNCHED_FORMAT ? 'launched' : 'unreadable';", "=== LAUNCHED_FORMAT ? 'launched' : 'absent';"),
    ('open-follows-links', L, OPEN_FLAGS, 'fs.constants.O_RDONLY | fs.constants.O_NONBLOCK'),
    ('open-blocks', L, OPEN_FLAGS, 'fs.constants.O_RDONLY | fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW'),
    ('any-file-type', L, "    if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX) return 'unreadable';", "    if (stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX) return 'unreadable';"),
    ('no-size-bound', L, "    if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX) return 'unreadable';", "    if (!stat.isFile()) return 'unreadable';"),
    ('form-refusal-unreadable-line-off', L,
     "  if (state === 'unreadable') return 'the run\\'s launched marker is present but cannot be read as the one Syzygy writes, so no launch form counts, declared or syzygy-launched';\n", ''),
    ('expected-launch-unreadable-as-operator', L,
     "  return 'a countable launch (the run\\'s launched marker is present but unreadable, so none counts)';", "  return 'a terminal or bang launch';"),
    ('allow-execution-unreadable-admitted', CLI, "    if (marker === 'unreadable') {", "    if (String(marker) === 'never') {"),
    ('allow-execution-launched-admitted', CLI, "    if (marker === 'launched') {", "    if (String(marker) === 'never') {"),
    ('launch-form-unreadable-admitted', H, "  if (marker === 'unreadable') return refuse('form',", "  if (String(marker) === 'never') return refuse('form',"),
    ('rule-launched-reason-off', R, "  if (launched === 'launched') reasons.push(", "  if (String(launched) === 'never') reasons.push("),
    ('rule-unreadable-reason-off', R, "  if (launched === 'unreadable') reasons.push(", "  if (String(launched) === 'never') reasons.push("),
    ('rule-reads-marker-eagerly', R, "  if (inputs.role !== 'authoring') return sec3(", "  inputs.launched();\n  if (inputs.role !== 'authoring') return sec3("),
    ('brief-marker-not-read', B, 'launched: () => launchedMarkerState(run),', "launched: () => 'absent' as const,"),
    ('inventory-brief-marker-not-read', I, 'launched: () => launchedMarkerState(opened.run),', "launched: () => 'absent' as const,"),
    ('inventory-of-record-wording-reverted', I, WORDING,
     "is not ${launchedMarkerState(run) === 'launched' ? 'a syzygy-launched launch' : 'a terminal or bang launch'} of that session's prompt"),
    # syzygy-bpyt.8.12: the size bound at fstat, at both edges.
    ('fstat-bound-inclusive', L, SIZE_CHECK, SIZE_CHECK.replace('stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX', 'stat.size >= MARKER_BYTES_MAX')),
    ('fstat-bound-one-past', L, SIZE_CHECK, SIZE_CHECK.replace('stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX', 'stat.size > MARKER_BYTES_MAX + 1')),
    # The bounded read: reverted to the base's read to end-of-file, and one mutant per predicate of the read.
    ('read-unbounded', L, BOUNDED_READ, "    const marker = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(fd, 'utf8')) as unknown;\n"),
    ('read-bound-check-off', L, READ_CHECK, ''),
    ('read-bound-inclusive', L, READ_CHECK, READ_CHECK.replace('length > MARKER_BYTES_MAX', 'length >= MARKER_BYTES_MAX')),
    ('read-bound-one-past', L, READ_CHECK, READ_CHECK.replace('length > MARKER_BYTES_MAX', 'length > MARKER_BYTES_MAX + 1')),
    ('read-buffer-at-bound', L, '    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(MARKER_BYTES_MAX + 1);', '    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(MARKER_BYTES_MAX);'),
    ('read-once', L, LOOP, '    length = fs.readSync(fd, bytes, 0, bytes.length, null);\n'),
    ('read-no-end-of-file-stop', L, '      if (read === 0) break;\n', ''),
    ('read-loop-past-buffer', L, '    while (length < bytes.length) {', '    while (length <= bytes.length) {'),
    # R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-2 X1, X2, X3 (round 2, section 3 item 7).
    ('review-of-record-wording-reverted', V, WORDING,
     "is not ${launchedMarkerState(run) === 'launched' ? 'a syzygy-launched launch' : 'a terminal or bang launch'} of that session's prompt"),
    ('brief-reads-marker-eagerly', B, 'launched: () => launchedMarkerState(run),', 'launched: ((state) => () => state)(launchedMarkerState(run)),'),
    ('inventory-brief-reads-marker-eagerly', I, 'launched: () => launchedMarkerState(opened.run),', 'launched: ((state) => () => state)(launchedMarkerState(opened.run)),'),
]

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout

def run_suite():
    proc = subprocess.Popen(COMMAND, cwd=ROOT, env={**os.environ, 'CI': '1'}, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        log, _ = proc.communicate(timeout=TIMEOUT)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        proc.communicate()
        return None, None, []
    text = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', log.decode('utf8', 'replace'))
    tests = next((line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('Tests ')), None)
    failed = sorted({line.strip()[2:].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith('× ')})
    return proc.returncode, tests, failed

def main():
    subjects = sorted({m[1] for m in MUTANTS})
    originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_bytes() for f in subjects}
    clean_before = git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == ''
    base_exit, base_tests, base_failed = run_suite()
    results = []
    try:
        for mutant_id, path, old, new in MUTANTS:
            text = originals[path].decode('utf8')
            assert text.count(old) == 1, (mutant_id, old)
            (ROOT / path).write_bytes(text.replace(old, new).encode('utf8'))
            try:
                code, tests, failed = run_suite()
            finally:
                (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
            blocked = code is None
            results.append({'id': mutant_id, 'file': path, 'old': old, 'new': new, 'exitCode': code, 'testsLine': tests, 'failedTests': failed,
                            'blocked': blocked, 'outcome': 'killed' if blocked or (code != 0 and failed) else 'survived',
                            'restored': sha((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == sha(originals[path])})
            print(mutant_id, results[-1]['outcome'], tests or ('blocked' if blocked else ''), flush=True)
    finally:
        for path in subjects:
            (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
    record = {
        'subject': subjects, 'subjectSha256': {f: sha(originals[f]) for f in subjects}, 'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.12',
        'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'command': ' '.join(COMMAND), 'timeoutSeconds': TIMEOUT,
        'trackedTreeCleanBefore': clean_before, 'unmutated': {'exitCode': base_exit, 'testsLine': base_tests, 'failedTests': base_failed},
        'mutants': results, 'trackedTreeCleanAfter': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == '',
        'summary': {'planned': len(MUTANTS), 'killed': sum(r['outcome'] == 'killed' for r in results)},
        'harnessSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('summary', record['summary'])

main()

round2Correction.text: The round-2 record called any-file-type "Equivalent at every fixture an unprivileged test can build". It is not (R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-2 R2-N2): a FIFO holding the marker's bytes reads launched under it. launched.test.ts now plants that FIFO, and the mutant is killed here. The round-2 record is not edited.

sizeBound.text: Mutants of the bound at fstat and of the bounded read, with the outcome and the failed tests of each. With both bounds in place a static file past 4096 bytes is refused by either, so the fstat bound is held only by a file that shrinks after fstat, and the read bound only by a file that grows after it.

equivalentSurvivors.inventory-brief-marker-not-read: Equivalent by design (R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-1 N4, confirmed by R-GP-IMPL-LAUNCHED-MARKER-2 section 4): the inventory brief is not the authoring brief, so the execution rule returns before it calls the launched thunk. The eager-read mutant at the same line (inventory-brief-reads-marker-eagerly) is killed.
equivalentSurvivors.read-loop-past-buffer: Equivalent: the loop guard differs only once the buffer is full (4097 bytes read), and from there every path returns unreadable: the extra read asks for 0 bytes at the end of the buffer and returns 0 (or throws, which the catch maps to unreadable), the loop breaks, and 4097 > 4096 is refused.
